spec.description: Health monitoring dashboard for our Clickhouse Operator

spec.title: Memory usage
spec.description: Indicates the Memory usage over time of clickhouse operator

spec.title: Service status
spec.description: Indicated whether clickhouse operator is up in the clusters it's deployed in

spec.title: PodDelete events [5m]
spec.description:
Number of clickhouse pods deleted (either shards or replicas)
(it is quite logical to see similar data for added and deleted pods as when a reconciliation occur a pod is terminated and a new one is created to replaced it, it is not a restart of a pod)

spec.title: Auto-recoveries [5m]
spec.description: auto-recoveries occur when the operator automatically stepped in and triggered a recovery to fix a broken/crashed host(pod)

spec.title: Host reconcile errors increase total [5m]
spec.description:
Indicicates the number of errors that occured during a host (clickhouse pod) reconciliation over 5m for $cluster

Legends is <cluster>/<product>/<project>

spec.title: Last restart
spec.description: Amount of time since last restart of the clickhouse operator

spec.title: Opened Threads (Go)
spec.description: Number of go opened threads (a spike might indicate deadlock)

spec.title: Host reconcile errors increase by (chi) [5m]
spec.description: Indicicates the number of errors that occured during a host (clickhouse pod) reconciliation over $interval for $cluster aggregated by chi

spec.title: Host reconciliation latency [5m]
spec.description: Indicicates the time in milliseconds it takes for a host (clickhouse pod) to reconcile with the desired state of the ClickHouseInstallation CR

spec.title: PodAdd events [5m]
spec.description:
Number of clickhouse pods added (either shards or replicas)
(it is quite logical to see similar data for added and deleted pods as when a reconciliation occur a pod is terminated and a new one is created to replaced it, it is not a restart of a pod)

spec.title: Pod events (clickhouse pods added or deleted, either shards or replicas)
